description: Change of use of part of the moorings from serviced leisure boat moorings to create five residential boat moorings and retain four leisure boat moorings as existing
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (TA01, 1037-01-F02 , 1037-01-F01, Ecology Statement (JPP0723-L-2012-001), Flood Risk Assessment October 2012 (WFP:1349969501), Planning Statement received 12/11/2012; Operational Management Plan January 2013 (1037-01), Sample Mooring Agreement received 03/01/2012) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The hereby approved use of the site shall be undertaken in accordance with the submitted Operational Management Plan dated January 2013 (ref. 1037-01).

Condition : 4 - In accordance with the approved Operational Management Plan dated January 2013 (ref. 1037-01), refuse and recycling waste from the residential moorings shall be stored on board vessels and collected weekly by the moorings management company for disposal at the existing refuse/recycling facilities within the Ferry Quays development.
